FAQ

Common Questions

How long does credit repair take? +

Results vary based on your individual situation. Many clients see meaningful changes within 30–90 days, while more complex cases may take 6–12 months. We provide monthly updates so you always know your progress. Individual results may vary.

Can you guarantee a specific score increase? +

By law, no company can guarantee specific score increases or removal of accurate negative information. What we can guarantee is our commitment to challenging every inaccuracy, staying in your corner, and equipping you with the best strategies available.

What items can be disputed on my credit report? +

We can challenge inaccurate or outdated items including collections, late payments, charge-offs, hard inquiries, bankruptcies, repossessions, and identity errors. Accurate, verifiable items cannot be legally removed — we will always be honest with you about what's possible.

Do you work with clients nationwide? +

Yes! GNI Consulting Services proudly serves clients nationwide. All consultations, coaching sessions, and progress updates are conducted virtually, making it easy and convenient wherever you are.

How is GNI Consulting different from doing it myself? +

While you have the right to dispute items yourself, the process can be overwhelming and time-consuming. Our experts know the laws (FCRA, FDCPA), the bureau processes, and the most effective strategies — so you get faster, more effective results with personalized support every step of the way.

Disclaimer: GNI Consulting Services provides credit education and dispute assistance services. Individual results may vary. We cannot guarantee removal of any specific item or a specific credit score increase. We comply fully with the Credit Repair Organizations Act (CROA) and the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA). You have the right to dispute inaccurate information directly with credit bureaus at no charge. Services are not legal advice.
